---
title: "Initial Data Analysis"
output: html_notebook
---
``` {r Load packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(stats)
library(ggplot2)
```

``` {r Load clean data}
clean_data <- read.csv("cleaned_eug_spd.csv")
```

```{r Group data}
avg_by_year <- clean_data %>%
  group_by(yr, agency) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_response_time = mean(mins_to_arrv, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )
```

```{r Plot average response times over time}
ggplot(avg_by_year, aes(x = yr, y = avg_response_time, color = agency, group = agency)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Average Response Time (minutes)",
    color = "Agency"
  )
```
